blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Chilliwack River Valley

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Chilliwack River Valley are served by Cultus Lake Community School, Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in Chilliwack School District 33 (SD33). Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Chilliwack River Provincial Park, Tamihi Rapids, Slesse Park, Thompson Regional Park, the Trans Canada Trail, and Chilliwack Lake Provincial Park. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by private vehicle travel via Chilliwack Lake Road to Vedder Crossing and Garrison Crossing (approx. 10 to 25 minutes west), where BC Transit Route 51 Vedder and Route 58 Cultus Lake connect.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Chilliwack River Valley

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Chilliwack River Valley are regulated by the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) Official Community Plan for Electoral Area E (Bylaw No. 1115), FVRD Zoning Bylaw No. 1638, and FVRD Riparian Areas, Geotechnical Hazard, and Floodplain regulations. Before removing subjects on a property in Chilliwack River Valley, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

blocks.text: Chilliwack River Valley Real Estate FAQs

parts.t: What types of homes are for sale in Chilliwack River Valley?

Active MLS® listings in Chilliwack River Valley typically include rural detached houses on 0.5- to 5-acre forested and river-bench lots, recreational cabins, custom log homes, and gated bare-land strata properties in Baker Trails. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Chilliwack River Valley in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Chilliwack River Valley include Cultus Lake Community School, Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in Chilliwack School District 33 (SD33). Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Chilliwack River Valley?

Residents of Chilliwack River Valley have access to Chilliwack River Provincial Park, Tamihi Rapids, Slesse Park, Thompson Regional Park, the Trans Canada Trail, and Chilliwack Lake Provincial Park. See our
Chilliwack River Valley Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Chilliwack River Valley?

Key road corridors serving Chilliwack River Valley include Chilliwack Lake Road (east of the Vedder Crossing bridge), Tamihi Way, Slesse Park Road, Baker Trails, and Bell Acres. Public transit connections include private vehicle travel via Chilliwack Lake Road to Vedder Crossing and Garrison Crossing (approx. 10 to 25 minutes west), where BC Transit Route 51 Vedder and Route 58 Cultus Lake connect.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Chilliwack River Valley?

Properties in Chilliwack River Valley are governed by the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) Official Community Plan for Electoral Area E (Bylaw No. 1115), FVRD Zoning Bylaw No. 1638, and FVRD Riparian Areas, Geotechnical Hazard, and Floodplain regulations. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Chilliwack River Valley freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Chilliwack River Valley are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
